model: nhl-1: baseline last 5 @0.25 + last season as 40 games; spread pooled 2021-26 by volume (saves: last 2 seasons), early-season spread

out.name: Ryan Poehling
out.note: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.

out.name: Ian Moore
out.note: Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.

out.name: Joonas Korpisalo
out.note: Korpisalo (lower body) will miss at least four more weeks, per Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet on Saturday.

out.name: Igor Shesterkin
out.note: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

out.name: Travis Konecny
out.note: Konecny (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to the NHL media site.

out.name: Rasmus Ristolainen
out.note: Ristolainen (upper body) won't travel with the Flyers ahead of Thursday's game against the Red Wings but is closing in on a return, Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports reports.

out.name: Chris Tanev
out.note: The Maple Leafs announced Thursday that Tanev (lower body) is considered week-to-week, Mark Masters of TSN reports.

out.name: Justin Brazeau
out.note: Brazeau (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Penguins on Sunday.

out.name: Michael Carcone
out.note: Carcone is week-to-week due to his upper-body injury, the team announced Saturday.
